name: opencv
description: Analyze an image with OpenCV. ops: info (size, brightness, sharpness), edges (Canny), contours (bounding boxes), faces (Haar cascade), grayscale, resize. Input: {"op": "info", "path": "docs/assets/mascot.jpg", "options": {}}. options keys the guest actually reads: edges uses threshold1/threshold2 (defaults 100/200); contours uses min_area (default 100); resize needs width and/or height (the missing side is scaled). Written images land in state/opencv/.
llm_description: Analyze/transform an image with OpenCV. op: info|edges|contours|faces|grayscale|resize. Input: {op, path, options?}. options: edges {threshold1?,threshold2?} (default 100/200); contours {min_area?} (default 100); resize {width? and/or height?} (missing side is scaled). Written images land in state/opencv/.

op.description: Operation to perform. Defaults to info.

options.description: Per-op knobs. Unused keys are ignored.

threshold1.description: Canny low threshold for edges. Default 100.

threshold2.description: Canny high threshold for edges. Default 200.

min_area.description: Minimum contour area in pixels for contours. Default 100.

width.description: Target width for resize. If only height is set, width is scaled.

height.description: Target height for resize. If only width is set, height is scaled.
